summary: I built the opt-in cloud placeholder test as designed. tests/CfProvider is a framework-dependent console that runs as its own process: it registers a real cldflt sync root, creates the placeholders and never answers a callback. It is listed in FsAnalyser.slnx and ProjectReferenced by Core.Tests. CloudPlaceholderTests.cs is Trait-gated (Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT) and holds a private nested SyncRootRig plus two Facts that drive the shipped Scanner.Scan and SynchronousIoCancel: a stalled fetch freed by Cancel, and a dehydrated tree read with true sizes and no hydration. It also holds two Facts that register nothing and prove a provider that cannot start fails the Fact and never skips it. The default suite gained a pure helper (CloudRig: pid-named roots, strict sweep, pid-filtered callback parsing, muxer derivation), ScanDeadline (kills the provider and fails once a cancelled scan passes its deadline), OptInTraitTests (checks every Trait against the FsaDefaultTestFilter baked into the assembly), and default-suite tests for each of these. All 11 accepted critique fixes are in. With the repo-local SDK 10.0.401 that eng/dotnet.ps1 bootstrapped (Q-003), the default suite went from 296 to 332 tests, all passing, and none of the gated tests ran in it. The two stall and tree Facts register a real sync root, so I did not run them: whether that may happen on this PC is design open question 1, which nobody has answered.

files.why: Helper Exe: framework-dependent, AllowUnsafeBlocks, IsTestProject=false. It does not reference Core.

The provider. Scenarios stall, tree and silent. Registers with flag 2, population FULL, hydration PARTIAL, HardLink ALLOWED, then connects with flags 6 using [UnmanagedCallersOnly] callbacks. Prints REGISTERED, READY, CB pid/path lines and ERR api hr lines, and exits on stdin EOF. Struct layouts are lifted from the SL-024 re-spike.

The Trait-gated class: the stall Fact, the tree Fact, and two provider-cannot-start Facts. It holds the private nested SyncRootRig (sweep, pid-named root, muxer exec launch, READY/ERR deadline, RunScan through ScanDeadline, crash-only teardown with pass-gated rethrow) and a private CfUnregisterSyncRoot import.

The rig's pure parts, testable in the default suite: root naming, strict stale-root regex plus pid liveness, Sweep with an injected unregister, parsing of the provider's callback lines with the pid filter, and MuxerFor.
M2: runs the scan on its own thread. If the scan is still running a grace period after cancel, it frees it by force (the rig kills the provider) and fails. Every rig scan goes through it.

Default-suite tests: the sweep's name predicate and the sweep itself (C-007), the pid filter (C-002), muxer derivation (m7), IsRunning, and the deadline's kill-then-fail branch on the shipped Scanner with a guard stand-in it cannot interrupt (C-003), plus control cases.

The guard EveryOptInTraitIsExcludedByTheDefaultFilter (C-011). Unfiltered() is strict: exact '&' clauses, and any '|' or '(' is refused. A Theory feeds it the missing-clause, OR, prefix, shorter-value, parenthesised, ad-hoc and empty filters (C-012, m3).
M1: FsaDefaultTestFilter (adds Cloud!=CF-SYNC-ROOT) feeds VSTestTestCaseFilter and AssemblyMetadata DefaultTestFilter. Adds the ProjectReference to CfProvider.
InteropLivesOnlyInNative now exempts CloudPlaceholderTests.cs and tests\CfProvider\, because the design puts DllImports there. Patterns are unchanged, so rules-parity still agrees.

Both InteropLivesOnlyInNative twins get the same two exemptions. The SL-049 settled entries are widened per M3: cldapi and the Cf verb set on src; cldapi, Cf verbs, CfProvider and SyncRootRig on Core.Tests. Per m2, FsAnalyser\.Core is added to the provider rule.

obligations.how: StalledFetchIsFreedByCancelThroughTheShippedGuard feeds this shape. 'ok' is population-disabled with f1/f2/f3.txt and lists before 'stall' (flags NONE, never answered). The Fact waits up to 10 s for this process's FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS on stall, holds 3 s, cancels, and allows 5 s. It then asserts Cancelled, CancelsDelivered >= 1, the provider still alive, and ok's 3 files at their declared sizes. BUILT BUT NEVER RUN: it registers a real sync root, and open question 1 (may that happen on this PC) is unanswered.

CloudRigTests.OnlyThisProcesssCallbacksCountAsTheScans feeds FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS and FETCH_DATA lines from pid+1, pid*10+1, pid*10, pid+2 and pid 0, alongside this process's own lines and paths containing spaces. It asserts only pid == Environment.ProcessId counts, and that the other lines were parsed and excluded by pid alone. The rig's WaitForCallback and Callbacks use the same filter. Ran and passed.

CloudRigTests.AScanCancelDoesNotFreeIsFreedByForceAndFails runs the shipped Scanner with a first call blocked on an event that CancelSynchronousIo cannot interrupt (a regressed-guard stand-in). ScanDeadline sees it still running 0.5 s after Cancel, calls the force-free (the rig's version kills the provider), and fails without hanging. The scan then ends Cancelled. A control test covers a scan the guard does free. Ran and passed. Killing the provider to free a real cldflt wait is the path spike 4 measured. Freeing a pending FETCH_DATA that way remains unmeasured.

The stall Fact pins the characterization: 'stall' is an EntryKind.Folder with 0 children and is not in ScanResult.Unreadable, and a comment names spike 1 constraint 2. NEVER RUN, for the open question 1 reason given under O-001.

AProviderThatCannotStartFailsWithItsOwnError: CfRegisterSyncRoot on a missing folder makes the rig fail with 'ERR CfRegisterSyncRoot hr=0x80070002', exit 2, and nothing registered. AProviderThatCannotStartSilentlyIsKilledAndFails: the 'silent' scenario with a 2 s READY deadline is killed, and the failure carries its stderr. Neither registers anything, so I ran both by name through eng/dotnet.ps1 test --filter. Both passed, teardown took 1 ms, and no fsa-cf-* folder was left.

Every stall Fact run tears down this way: Dispose kills the provider while stall is unpopulated and its FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS is still pending in cldflt, then unregisters and deletes. Each step is bounded to 10 s and caught. The class remarks assign validate the three runs in a row, if the person allows the run. NEVER RUN here, for the open question 1 reason.

CloudRigTests.TheSweepRemovesOnlyTheRootOfARunThatIsGone uses a real TempTree. It holds a dead-pid fsa-cf-<pid>-<32hex> root with contents, this process's live root, six look-alike folders and a file named like a root. It asserts that only the stale root is unregistered and deleted, in under 10 s, and nothing else is touched. The OnlyARootOfARunThatIsGoneIsStale Theory feeds 15 names. Unregister is injected in that test; the real unregister of a dead-provider root is the cldapi call spike 4 measured. Ran and passed.

DehydratedPlaceholdersAreTraversedWithTrueSizesAndNeverHydrated. a, a\sub and b are population-disabled placeholder folders holding 5 MiB, 12345 B, 3 MiB (nested) and 1 MiB files. The Fact asserts Completed with nothing Unreadable, the folders are Folder (not Link) and entered, each file's Size is its declared size with OnDisk 0, and each folder's totals are the sums below it. NEVER RUN, for the open question 1 reason.

The tree Fact's last section is marked UNMEASURED (m6). It checks that b\f4-link.bin (CreateHardLinkW, HardLink ALLOWED) has the same file ID as f4.bin, that exactly one of the two names is HardlinkDuplicate, and that b charges 1 MiB over 2 files and the total is 9 MiB + 12345. NEVER RUN, for the open question 1 reason.

The tree Fact runs under a 30 s CancelAfter plus the ScanDeadline kill. A hydrating scan would block on the never-answering provider, and the Fact would fail on Status. It also asserts zero FETCH_DATA from this process and that every file still carries RECALL_ON_DATA_ACCESS, re-read by name after the scan under the same deadline. NEVER RUN, for the open question 1 reason.

The csproj default filter now excludes Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT, and EveryOptInTraitIsExcludedByTheDefaultFilter checks it mechanically. The actual default run: eng/dotnet.ps1 test with no --filter gave 332 passed, and the trx shows 0 CloudPlaceholderTests executed. --list-tests --filter Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT lists exactly the 4 gated Facts.

OptInTraitTests.AFilterThatLeavesATraitInIsCaught feeds the pure Unfiltered() a missing clause, the OR form, a longer value (CF-SYNC-ROOT2), a shorter value, a parenthesised filter, an opt-in run's own filter, an ad-hoc FullyQualifiedName filter and an empty filter. Each must report the Traits it leaves in. Ran and passed.

FsaDefaultTestFilter holds the default. VSTestTestCaseFilter takes it under the existing empty-condition, and AssemblyMetadata DefaultTestFilter bakes FsaDefaultTestFilter. I verified with a build under --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~CloudPlaceholderTests.AProviderThatCannotStart|FullyQualifiedName~OptInTraitTests' (not --no-build): the guard passed, so the ad-hoc filter was not baked in.

SyncRootRig.RunScan(cts, grace, whileRunning) runs every scan through ScanDeadline.Run. The stall Fact's deadline is cancel + 5 s; the tree Fact's is CancelAfter 30 s + 5 s, and its attribute re-read is bounded the same way. On a miss the rig kills the provider and fails. The branch is exercised in the default suite (O-003). As the disposition says, killing to free a pending FETCH_DATA is unmeasured and not claimed.

SyncRootRig is a private nested class of the [Trait("Cloud","CF-SYNC-ROOT")] class, and the CfUnregisterSyncRoot import is a private nested class too. The Fitness rules are widened: src gets (?i)cldapi and \bCf(Register|Unregister|Connect|Disconnect|Execute|Hydrate|Dehydrate|Create|Convert|Update|SetInSyncState)\w*. Core.Tests gets those plus CfProvider and SyncRootRig, except CloudPlaceholderTests.cs and ArchitectureRulesTests.cs (see deviations). A raw-regex scan of the tree against those patterns found no match. Case (c), an untraited second class in the exempt file, is still a matter for code review, as the disposition says.

The class remarks say whether a sync root may be registered is a person's decision (open question 1). A declined run leaves the shipped guard on a real cloud folder not reached, with SL-049's spike the only contact, and never counts as a pass. I followed that myself: I did not run the stall or tree Fact, and I report them not-run.

Added 'FsAnalyser\.Core' as a must_not_match on tests/CfProvider/** (csproj and .cs), beside <ProjectReference and must_not_import. The provider's files never name it, even in comments. The regex scan is clean.
Unfiltered() refuses a filter containing '|', '(' or ')', splits on '&', and requires exact Name!=Value clause equality. The Theory includes the OR case and the prefix (CF-SYNC-ROOT2) case.

Roots are named %TEMP%\fsa-cf-<testhost pid>-<32 lower hex>. The sweep matches ^fsa-cf-(?<pid>[1-9][0-9]{0,9})-[0-9a-f]{32}$ and removes a root only when that pid is not running. A pid this token cannot open counts as running, and link folders are skipped.

The sweep's name and liveness predicate, and the sweep itself with an injected unregister, live in CloudRig.cs outside the gated class, with default-suite tests. The kill-on-missed-deadline branch is exercised in the default suite too, which goes beyond the disposition's 'reasoning only'. The class remarks say validate runs the opt-in filter three times in a row, if allowed.

Every hardlink-dependent assertion sits after the size, on-disk, folder-total, zero-FETCH_DATA and RECALL checks, each prefixed 'UNMEASURED (SL-049 m6), a counting-rule question for the person and not a test to patch'. Those are: b's two names, the link's row, the Files count, the shared file ID, the duplicate flag, b's charge and the byte total.

CloudRig.MuxerFor uses new DirectoryInfo(Path.TrimEndingDirectorySeparator(dir)).Parent.Parent.Parent. A Theory covers the path with and without the trailing separator, and TheRunningRuntimesMuxerExists checks the real runtime. A missing muxer, CfProvider.dll and runtimeconfig each get their own message, and only the CfProvider.dll message names the ProjectReference.

Dispose runs the kill, unregister and delete steps on a bounded thread (10 s each), catches each failure and writes it to the test output. It throws only when the Fact called rig.Passed(), which every Fact does as its last line. Leftovers are left for the next run's sweep.

deviations: The trait guard lives in a new OptInTraitTests.cs, not in ArchitectureRulesTests.cs as designed. eng/rules-parity.ps1, which RuleCopiesAgreeTests runs in the default suite, requires every [Fact]/[Theory] in ArchitectureRulesTests to be exactly one AssertNoMatch call paired with a fitness.yaml twin. A reflection Fact, or its negative Theory, there would read as CANNOT-READ or DRIFT and turn the default suite red.

The existing InteropLivesOnlyInNative rule (both the xUnit Fact and its two yaml twins) forbids (Library|Dll)Import in tests/**/*.cs outside TestNative.cs. The design missed this while putting a cldapi DllImport in CloudPlaceholderTests.cs and a provider under tests/CfProvider. I added exactly those two to its exemptions in both copies. Patterns are unchanged, so rules-parity still reports AGREE 11 facts <- 15 twinned entries.

The widened confinement rule (M3) also excepts ArchitectureRulesTests.cs. The interop Fact must name tests\CfProvider\ to exempt it, and the literal 'CfProvider' pattern the M3 fix specified would otherwise fail the tree. The yaml because-text records why.

The cloud Facts do not join a shared [Collection] with SynchronousIoCancelTests. SynchronousIoCancel.Created is [ThreadStatic], not a process-wide static. The counters belong to each guard, which each Fact captures on its own scan thread, and SynchronousIoCancelTests declares no collection. Parallel tests therefore cannot contaminate CancelsDelivered, and joining would mean editing that class for no effect.

Additions to the provider contract. A REGISTERED line, so teardown unregisters only a root that was actually registered. Callbacks registered and reported for CANCEL_FETCH_DATA and CANCEL_FETCH_PLACEHOLDERS, for diagnostics only. A 'silent' scenario that registers nothing and prints no READY, to feed C-005's no-READY shape. Paths are printed as VolumeDosName+NormalizedPath, and the callback parser tolerates spaces in them.

There are two gated Facts beyond the design's 'two Facts only': AProviderThatCannotStartFailsWithItsOwnError and AProviderThatCannotStartSilentlyIsKilledAndFails. They feed C-005 and register no sync root, which is why they could be run here.

The rig's roots are fsa-cf-<pid>-<32hex>, and the sweep keys on whether that pid is alive, per the accepted m4 fix, not the design's fsa-cf-<32hex>. The scan runs on a dedicated background thread inside ScanDeadline rather than Task.Run. That keeps a scan the kill cannot free off the thread pool, and puts the [ThreadStatic] Created seam on the scanning thread.

Tree Fact, per m6: b's child count, the link's own row, the Files total and the Bytes total all depend on the hardlink, so they moved into the unmeasured section after the FETCH_DATA check. The CloudOnly flag is logged, not asserted: the design never asked for it and no spike measured it.

tests.note: There was no 10.0 SDK (only 8.0.425 and 9.0.318), so eng/dotnet.ps1 downloaded SDK 10.0.401 (300,608,304 bytes) into the gitignored .dotnet/ as the ordinary user, as Q-003 authorises. It lists 10.0.401.
Baseline before any change: 296 passed, 0 failed.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 build FsAnalyser.slnx --no-incremental -v q
tests.note: After the change: 0 warnings, 0 errors. CfProvider.dll, .exe, .deps.json and .runtimeconfig.json are copied into the Core.Tests bin.
48 passed, including InteropLivesOnlyInNative with the new exemptions and RuleCopiesAgreeTests (rules-parity AGREE).

This is the real opt-in entry point with an explicit filter and a filtered build. 12 passed. The provider started through the running runtime's muxer with the tests' runtimeconfig. cldapi bound and Windows answered 'ERR CfRegisterSyncRoot hr=0x80070002', exit 2. The silent provider was killed at 2 s and its stderr appeared in the failure. Teardown took 1 ms each time. The guard passed on a build made under an ad-hoc filter, so the M1 fix works. There were no fsa-cf-* folders in %TEMP% before or after. No sync root was registered.
Default run with no --filter: 332 passed, 0 failed (296 + 36 new). The trx shows 0 CloudPlaceholderTests, StalledShareTests or TEST-NET-1 tests executed.
Solution-level run: 332 passed. CfProvider is not treated as a test project.
Listing only, nothing ran. It selects exactly the 4 CloudPlaceholderTests Facts.

Not run because the stall and tree Facts register a real cldflt sync root under %TEMP%, and design open question 1 (may that happen on this PC) is unanswered. So StalledFetchIsFreedByCancelThroughTheShippedGuard and DehydratedPlaceholdersAreTraversedWithTrueSizesAndNeverHydrated have never run. C-001, C-004, C-006, C-008, C-009 and C-010 rest on them, and Derived 3 stays not reached until someone allows the run.

tests.command: PowerShell regex scan emulating the SL-049 settled Fitness entries (src, Core.Tests except the two exempt files, tests/CfProvider), comments included
tests.note: No matches. I could not run the engine's own Fitness op=check: no Fitness tool or engine interpreter is available in this session.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 -Case C-001 (and C-002 to C-005)
tests.note: C-002, C-004 and C-005 hold. C-001 (4 checks) and C-003 (2 checks) fail on the pinned string '28 settled entries not compared'. HEAD already has 32 settled entries, from slices after SL-031 (git show HEAD:.taad/fitness.yaml), so these two cases fail independently of this slice; its 3 entries make 35. The pattern and fact counts they check (AGREE 11 facts <- 15 twinned entries, 27 patterns) are unchanged.

tests.command: Scratch console in %TEMP% (since deleted), built with .dotnet, printing sizeof and Marshal.OffsetOf for the provider's structs
tests.note: CF_SYNC_REGISTRATION 72 (ProviderId@52), CF_SYNC_POLICIES 24, CF_CALLBACK_REGISTRATION 16, CF_CALLBACK_INFO VolumeDosName@32 NormalizedPath@104 (as the re-spike measured) ProcessInfo@136 RequestKey@144, CF_PROCESS_INFO.ProcessId@4, CF_PLACEHOLDER_CREATE_INFO 88 (FileSize@48, FileIdentity@56, Flags@68, Result@72, CreateUsn@80). All match the x64 cldapi.h layout. This partly stands in for the unrun success path.
It needs the TAAD engine's interpreter and checkout, which this session does not have. It is relevant because the InteropLivesOnlyInNative exemptions changed in both engines' copies.

follow_ups: If the person answers open question 1 yes, validate runs `eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj --filter Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT` three times in a row. That is the first real run of the stall and tree Facts (Derived 3, C-001, C-004, C-006, C-008 to C-010) and of teardown after a killed provider. If the answer is no, those stay not reached.

tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1 C-001 and C-003 pin '28 settled entries not compared', but HEAD already has 32 (35 with this slice), so both cases fail independently of SL-049. Update the pin, or derive it from the file.

Run eng/rules-harness/harness.py with the TAAD engine to confirm both engines agree on the new InteropLivesOnlyInNative exemptions (CloudPlaceholderTests.cs, tests/CfProvider/**) and on the widened SL-049 settled patterns.
Killing the provider to free a scan blocked on a pending FETCH_DATA (M2) is unmeasured. The shipped scanner raises no FETCH_DATA, so only a deliberate hydrating stand-in could measure it.

Open question 2 is unchanged: a cancelled, stalled cloud folder shows as an empty Folder that is not in Unreadable. If the person wants it reported as not read, that belongs in a scanner slice, which would change the stall Fact's characterization on purpose.
This worktree now holds a 10.0.401 SDK in the gitignored .dotnet/ (about 300 MB download). Other worktrees will download their own unless a machine-wide 10.0 SDK is installed.
payload.reason: The build is complete. The stall and tree Facts, which register a real cldflt sync root, were deliberately not run because design open question 1 is unanswered. Their cases carry test commands for the engine or validate to run once someone allows it.
